assumptions.execution: prior-bar signal; next bar close; full fills
assumptions.holdout: last 30%; independent cash reset and 20-bar warmup; fixed parameters; no tuning

analysis: Fixed moving-average baseline produced 66 fills. Fees and slippage apply to strategy and buy-and-hold; final positions are liquidated. This short sample is not evidence of future profitability.

observations.text: The full-sample return of the strategy was 8.81%, which is lower than the buy-and-hold return of 21.80%.
The holdout period showed a positive return of 1.63%, outperforming the holdout buy-and-hold return of 0.74%, with a lower max drawdown of 4.07%.
The sample size is relatively short with only 66 fills in full-sample and 20 in holdout, limiting the ability to draw conclusions about future profitability.
